tara_marketing: Quick request for runtime team — before we publish the launch benchmarks we need a tight reproducible validation bundle that focuses on oddball tails: ultra-short prompts, very-long contexts, and tokenization edgecases (emoji, zero-width). Need CSV artifacts + small notebook.
aj_runtime: Can you list the exact test matrix and metrics you want captured?
tara_marketing: Metrics: p50/p95 latency, p50/p95/p99 sequence PPL, tokenization delta, and failure rate (OOM/timeouts). Matrix: models = opensf-chat-30b, opensf-chat-30b-int8, opensf-chat-30b-int4; cache_state = cold/warm; sampling = greedy/topk50; concurrencies = 1,8,24. Seq buckets: short (1-6), mid (128-512), long (~12k sliding).
zane_ml: For quantized runs include both int8 and int4. Also capture token counts and decoded roundtrip diffs so we can show tokenization quirks.
aj_runtime: We'll build a bench harness that emits CSV rows with: ts,req_id,model,quant_profile,cache_state,sampling,concurrency,seq_len,lat_ms,ppl_seq,tokens_out,exit_code. Example run command: `python tools/bench_runner.py --model opensf-chat-30b --quant int8 --input samples/validation.jsonl --warmup 32 --concurrency 8 --out results/edge-int8.csv`.
sophie_eng: To hit ~12k emulate via sliding-window; I'll stage a test pool with RUNTIME_MAX_SEQ=12288. ci-bot: deploy started by sophie_eng config update queued (build 9120).
aj_runtime: We'll run the full matrix tomorrow morning. Expect ~3-4 hours. Artifacts will be uploaded to gs://redwood-bench/launch/2204567890/ with a commit tag bench/launch/2204567890.
tara_marketing: Deliverables we need: raw CSVs, compressed traces, a minimal <200-line notebook that reproduces three plots (latency percentiles, PPL delta by quant, failure heatmap), and a README with exact commands and commit sha.
j:aj_runtime: We'll also run sampling vs greedy comparison and compute PPL variance; if p95 variance > 1.5x we'll flag.
tara_marketing: Perfect. We'll quote a short line in the post conditioned on results. Please post links here when uploads complete and call out any flaky cases. Thanks! :rocket:
